changelog:
- Initial 1.0.0 release of the `oo-gosquared` skill for operating GoSquared through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Adds read-only GoSquared actions for realtime Now overview and visitor time-series data.
- Supports Trends aggregate metric retrieval over a selected project time period.
- Includes token authorization inspection through `get_token_info`.
- Documents the standard `oo connector schema` and `oo connector run` workflow with server-side credential handling.
